Package com.github.crittscott.somestacks.util

Class StorageCubeIdx

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somestacks.util.StorageCubeIdx
public final class StorageCubeIdx extends Object
The geometry of a Storage Stack's 3 x 3 x 3 grid: where each of the 27 cells sits in the block and what box it occupies. Cells are separated by gaps, so the grid does not fill the block even when every slot is occupied.

GRID gives cell boxes at the block's layout rotation, a quarter turn of cell coordinates about the vertical axis, rather than moving the contents between slots.
